s: a male given name inherited from Old High German Answalt [in turn from Proto-Germanic *Ansuwaldaz], equivalent to English Oswald
Answald.et: From Old High German Answalt, from Proto-Germanic *Ansuwaldaz. Cognate with Faroese and Icelandic Ásvaldur, Norwegian Åsvald, English Oswald, Italian Ansaldo, and Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese Osvaldo.
